description: This file defines the 'Report' interface for the OrangeHRM system within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report' namespace. It declares methods related to retrieving report header definitions, filter definitions, and report data based on filter parameters.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: An interface defining methods for generating report headers, filters, and data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report, used to structure the report's table headers.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter definition for the report, used to specify filter criteria.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data based on provided filter parameters.
